name: The Stone of the Tides
summary: Off Stranglethorn Vale, strange reports from an island reach Baron Revilgaz. He suspects an ancient troll relic has resurfaced and sends you to scout the shore, with a pass to study it in Stormwind's archives.

sections.title: A Magnate's Ambition
sections.body: Strange apparitions and water elementals haunt an island off Stranglethorn Vale. Baron Revilgaz rules Booty Bay and suspects Gazban, a goblin mage, has found the fabled Stone of the Tides. He sends you to find the island and learn whether the rumors are true. To aid your search, he gives you a library scrip for Stormwind's scholars.

sections.title: An Ancient Ward
sections.body: The strange presence on the isle confirms Baron Revilgaz's hope: the legendary artifact is real. Claiming it will be difficult. The Stone of the Tides bears a powerful magical curse, and Revilgaz cannot break it alone. An experienced wizard must help before anyone can recover the relic.

faq.q: Who asks you to locate the haunted island?
aliases: quest giver stone of the tides
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz, ruler of Booty Bay, sends you to find the island after hearing tales of strange activity off the coast.

faq.q: Where is the haunted island located?
faq.answer: The island lies at sea off the coast of Stranglethorn Vale, and you must find it yourself.

faq.q: What is the Stone of the Tides?
aliases: what is stone of the tides
faq.answer: The Stone of the Tides is a legendary troll artifact Revilgaz hopes to add to his collection. He first read of its legend in an old book.

faq.q: Why does Baron Revilgaz want the artifact?
faq.answer: Baron Revilgaz wants the powerful troll relic for his collection of ancient artifacts and relics.

faq.q: What is the Library Scrip used for?
aliases: where do i take the scrip
faq.answer: You can take the scrip to Donyal Tovald at the Stormwind Library and receive a copy of the book where the baron first read of the legend.

faq.q: What was the previous step in this chain?
faq.answer: The Haunted Isle came before this investigation and first brought word of the strange sightings to Baron Revilgaz.
